markets.name: Farmers Market of Medina County
markets.about: The Farmers Market of Medina County is home to over 25 of your favorite local vendors that you have grown to love! Our Mission is the same as it has always been. We connect local farms and freshly made foods created with thought and respect for our local customers and community.

markets.name: Garrettsville Farmers Market
markets.addr: Main Street & High Street, Garrettsville, OH
markets.about: From fresh, locally grown produce to small batch artisan food and products, our vendors are committed to providing the highest level products and experience. Open each Thursday, 4:00-7:00pm June thru August on Main Street in downtown Garrettsville, Ohio.
markets.where: Grass area and closed public street
